name: Album Rating
author: Mark Deppe
description: Automatically calculates album ratings from track ratings (average, rounded half up) once a configurable share of the album's tracks has been rated.

threshold_percent.title: Minimum share of rated tracks (%)
threshold_percent.description: An album rating is only calculated once at least this share of the album's tracks has been rated.

remove_when_below.title: Remove the album rating when track ratings are removed and the share drops below the minimum

interval_minutes.title: Check interval (minutes)
interval_minutes.description: How often the plugin checks for changed track ratings.

scheduler.reason: Periodically check for changed track ratings

kvstore.reason: Store intermediate run state and the album ratings set by this plugin

subsonicapi.reason: Read track and album ratings and set album ratings

users.reason: Process the ratings of the authorized users
